product_metadata.title: V-Opitos Christmas Stocking Holders for Mantle, Set of 6 Metal Xmas Stocking Hangers, Adjustable Multi-uses Hooks for Fireplace, Christmas Home Supplies
features: Value Christmas Stocking Holders Set - The package contains 6 high-quality hooks, which are very suitable for hanging Christmas family stockings. It can also be used for hanging garlands, lights, and other Christmas ornaments. It is an ideal choice for family Christmas Supplies.

Adjustable Size To Match Fireplace - The Christmas stocking holders can be adjusted between 0.5 inches and 3 inches, which makes them suitable for mantels and fireplaces of almost any thickness and shape. At the same time, the High-quality metal raw materials keep it fixed after expansion and contraction. In this way, you can make it match your fireplace.

Easy To Use Without Any Tools - This hook is designed according to the principles of physics, you can place it on your mantel or desk to hang anything without nails or screws, providing you with the greatest convenience, also, you don’t need to worry about it leaving ugly marks after the holidays Or damaging the surface of your furniture.

Sturdy Metal Hook - This hook is made of high-quality iron, it is light and strong, and can withstand heavy Christmas stockings with gifts and other decorations weighing up to 10 pounds. The surface is electroplated, which is not only beautiful but also prevents oxidation and rust.
